_doc.zh: 节段质量占体重的比例和质心位置（占节段长度的比例，从近端端点量起），de Leva 1996 对 Zatsiorsky–Seluyanov 数据的调整。数值取自 BMClab/BMC 仓库里的两张表（CC BY 4.0），期刊原文没有打开。只用于对照我们由几何算出的节段质量，不参与计算。
_doc.en: Segment mass as a fraction of body mass and longitudinal centre-of-mass position (fraction of segment length from the proximal endpoint): de Leva's 1996 adjustments of the Zatsiorsky–Seluyanov data. Values are from the two tables in the BMClab/BMC repository (CC BY 4.0); the journal article itself was not opened. Used only as a cross-check of the segment masses computed from our geometry, never in the computation.

endpoints.head: vertex – mid-gonion
endpoints.upperArm: shoulder joint centre – elbow joint centre
endpoints.forearm: elbow joint centre – wrist joint centre
endpoints.thigh: hip joint centre – knee joint centre
endpoints.shank: knee joint centre – ankle joint centre
